CustomField.description: Indicates whether the Lead has been re-engaged after a period of inactivity or a previous unsuccessful sales attempt. This field is used to identify Leads that have re-entered the sales process for reporting, automation, and business process purposes.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Select this checkbox if the Lead has been re-engaged after previously becoming inactive, unresponsive, or otherwise exiting the active sales process.
CustomField.label: Re-engaged Lead
